promptEs: El acorde suena Si, Re, Fa y La♭, de grave a agudo. ¿Qué cifrado latino le corresponde?
promptEn: The chord sounds B, D, F and A♭, from low to high. Which American chord symbol matches it?
explanationEs: Si es la fundamental; Si-Re es una tercera menor, Si-Fa una quinta disminuida y Si-La♭ una séptima disminuida, nueve semitonos arriba. La calidad es disminuida con séptima disminuida: Sidim7. En americano se escribe Bdim7.
explanationEn: B is the root; B-D is a minor third, B-F a diminished fifth and B-A♭ a diminished seventh, nine semitones above. The quality is diminished with a diminished seventh: Bdim7. In Latin notation it is written Sidim7.
